finding.claim: When none of the named harnesses is installed but another one is, the summary line says kmctl is not installed here. With claude installed, remove --harness antigravity prints 'kmctl is not installed here (project scope); removed nothing', which is false.

fixes.change: When nothing named is installed but another harness is, the summary says removed nothing and names the harness still installed.
The reinstall test installs from a mirror URL and checks the uninstall name and the source kept; new tests check the summary line and that a failed uninstall names remove.
